method.title: How costs are counted
method.cost: Cost is what the provider reported for each request (OpenRouter reports it). Where no price was reported, rows show those requests' tokens instead — e.g. "$1.20 +45K tok".
method.tools: Tool cost is the request that read a tool's result back into the model, split by result size when one request read several.
method.features: Feature cost is the requests that read its tools' results. Base chat is the requests made before any tool ran.
method.local: Local runners (WebLLM, Wllama, Transformers.js, Ollama, LM Studio) cost $0 and count tokens only.
method.notCounted: Not counted yet: background memory and knowledge extraction, delegated sub-agents, and studio generations.
